```{r}
#Load libraries 
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(maps)
library(sf)
library(RColorBrewer)

```


```{r}
# compute distance in metres between two points (lat/lon)
coord_distance <- function(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2) {
  # ensure s2 is on
  sf::sf_use_s2(TRUE)

  # number of entries
  n <- length(lat2)

  # repeat reference coordinates if needed
  if (length(lat1) == 1) lat1 <- rep(lat1, n)
  if (length(lon1) == 1) lon1 <- rep(lon1, n)

  # result vector
  distances <- numeric(n)

  # loop element-wise
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {

    p1 <- st_sfc(st_point(c(lon1[i], lat1[i])), crs = 4326)
    p2 <- st_sfc(st_point(c(lon2[i], lat2[i])), crs = 4326)

    # st_distance returns a units object; convert to numeric
    distances[i] <- as.numeric(st_distance(p1, p2))
  }

  distances
}
```



```{r}
locations_2009 <- read_rds(here::here("processed_data", "clean_location_2009.rds"))

locations_2009 <- locations_2009 %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_id = 0
  )
```

```{r}
next_id <- 1
n <- nrow(locations_2009)
distance <- 40000


for (i in 1:(n-1)) {
  for (j in (i + 1):n) {
    
    # assign a cluster to i if it doesn't have one
    if (locations_2009$cluster_id[i] == 0) {
      locations_2009$cluster_id[i] <- next_id
      next_id <- next_id + 1
    }
    
    lat1 <- locations_2009$latitude[i]
    lon1 <- locations_2009$longitude[i]
    lat2 <- locations_2009$latitude[j]
    lon2 <- locations_2009$longitude[j]
    
    if (coord_distance(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2) <= distance) {
      
      if (locations_2009$cluster_id[j] == 0) {
        locations_2009$cluster_id[j] <- locations_2009$cluster_id[i]
      }
      else{
        locations_2009$cluster_id[locations_2009$cluster_id == locations_2009$cluster_id[j]] <- locations_2009$cluster_id[i]
      }
    }
    
    
  }
}

if (locations_2009$cluster_id[n] == 0){
  locations_2009$cluster_id[n] <- next_id
}


```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(maps)
library(sf)
library(igraph)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(here)
```

```{r}
# Compute geodesic distance in metres between two points (lat/lon)
coord_distance <- function(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2) {
  sf::sf_use_s2(TRUE)
  n <- length(lat2)
  if (length(lat1) == 1) lat1 <- rep(lat1, n)
  if (length(lon1) == 1) lon1 <- rep(lon1, n)
  distances <- numeric(n)
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    p1 <- st_sfc(st_point(c(lon1[i], lat1[i])), crs = 4326)
    p2 <- st_sfc(st_point(c(lon2[i], lat2[i])), crs = 4326)
    distances[i] <- as.numeric(st_distance(p1, p2))
  }
  distances
}
```

```{r}
locations_2009 <- read_rds(here::here("processed_data", "clean_location_connectivity.rds"))
```

```{r}
# ── SPATIAL CLUSTERING ────────────────────────────────────────
# Single-linkage clustering via graph connected components.
# Sites within distance_threshold of any other site in the
# cluster share a cluster ID.

distance_threshold <- 15000  # metres — change to test other distances

coords <- locations_2009 %>%
  dplyr::select(site, latitude, longitude)

# All pairwise distances
dist_mat <- outer(
  seq_len(nrow(coords)),
  seq_len(nrow(coords)),
  Vectorize(function(i, j) {
    coord_distance(
      coords$latitude[i], coords$longitude[i],
      coords$latitude[j], coords$longitude[j]
    )
  })
)

# Adjacency matrix — TRUE if within threshold
adj_mat <- dist_mat <= distance_threshold
diag(adj_mat) <- FALSE

# Connected components = clusters
g <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adj_mat, mode = "undirected")
locations_2009$cluster_id <- components(g)$membership

# Summary
cat("Distance threshold:", distance_threshold / 1000, "km\n")
cat("Number of clusters:", max(locations_2009$cluster_id), "\n")
cat("Cluster sizes:\n")
print(table(locations_2009$cluster_id))
```
